verdict.rationale: Pendo's Leo is documented as monitoring continuously in the background and sending alerts in Pendo and Slack without the user having to look. That is a first-party autonomous background capability, but the evidence never shows users defining their own automations (triggers, schedules, or actions that run unattended). Leo's action-taking (building guides and segments) is shown only inside a live conversation. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow builder, scheduled or triggered autonomous actions beyond alerting, depth documentation and independent corroboration.
